Package.Name: jq
Package.Summary: jq is a lightweight and flexible command-line JSON processor
Package.Description: jq is a lightweight and flexible command-line JSON processor akin tosed,awk,grep, and friends for JSON data. It's written in portable C and has zero runtime dependencies, allowing you to easily slice, filter, map, and transform structured data.
